[head=2][color=#535961]Shinohara Heavy Industries[/color][/head]
Shinohara is Crescent's largest corporate power. Its doctrine is continuity through infrastructure: governments change, but compatible parts, debt schedules, freight networks, clone records, and drydocks can keep producing revenue.
[head=3][color=#535961]Executive[/color][/head]
- [bold]Sector Manager.[/bold] Answers to the wider company for return, asset security, and future market position. - [bold]Assistant Manager.[/bold] Converts corporate goals into contracts, quotas, and branch policy between Tatsumoto, Prometheus Shipyards, and the wider hierarchy.
The branch also keeps a Human Resources office for personnel, discipline, housing, benefits, and the dependency built into employment. It is part of the org chart rather than a role a player can take.
[head=3][color=#535961]Security and staff[/color][/head]
- [bold]Head of CorpSec.[/bold] Directs protection of personnel, contracts, patents, and physical assets. - [bold]CorpSec Agent.[/bold] Prevents loss and keeps ordinary business operating. - [bold]Corporate Liquidation Agent.[/bold] The escalation the Head of CorpSec calls in once prevention has failed. Every use of force is still expected to have an accounting purpose. - [bold]Salaryman[/bold] and [bold]MedTech Researcher.[/bold] Keep the integrated commercial, medical, technical, and research system running.
Shinohara violence is judged by economic outcome. Protecting an asset without destroying its customers is better than winning an expensive battle for prestige.
For honorifics, see [textlink="Forms of Address" link="FormsOfAddress"].
